decisions.reason: The repeatedly gold-medaled flagship stollen has shown realized value, so the firm should keep committing to it rather than abandon it.
The seeded rye mixed bread costs little to hold on established recipes and shows no negative signal, so the option stays open.
Dark malt rye overlaps with other rye breads after Product A's removal, but its low holding cost and the lack of evidence of weak demand favor keeping it for now.
Marzipan stollen is a cheap seasonal complement to the core stollen business, and another Christmas season will reveal more about its value.
The ancient grain 'masterpiece' is still recent and differentiated, so its uncertain upside justifies keeping the option open.
